Verify an architecture against the tsfm contract

Source: R/conformance.R
tsfm_check_architecture.Rd

Runs the invariants in ?tsfm-architecture-contract against an architecture constructor and reports which hold. Use it while implementing a new architecture, and in that architecture's test suite as a regression gate.

tsfm_check_architecture(
  constructor,
  config = list(),
  weights = NULL,
  context = default_check_context(),
  h = 6L,
  quantile_levels = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9),
  tolerance = 1e-08,
  error = !interactive()
)

Arguments

constructor

A function (config, weights) returning a new_tsfm_model(), as passed to tsfm_register_arch().

config

A config list handed to constructor. Supply whatever the architecture needs; the default is empty.

weights

Weights handed to constructor. Default NULL.

context

Numeric context vector used for the probe forecasts. Defaults to a deterministic trend-plus-seasonality series of length 64.

h

Probe horizon.

quantile_levels

Probe quantile levels.

tolerance

Numerical tolerance for the batch-agreement check.

error

If TRUE (the default when called non-interactively), fail on the first violated invariant. If FALSE, return the full report so every problem is visible at once.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per check: name, ok (TRUE, FALSE, or NA for not applicable), and message.

Details

This checks contract conformance, not numerical correctness. An architecture can pass every check here and still forecast badly; matching the reference implementation is a separate gate, covered by golden parity fixtures (see tests/testthat/fixtures/README.md).

See also

?tsfm-architecture-contract

Examples

# A minimal conforming architecture: last value, with a Gaussian spread.
demo_arch <- function(config, weights) {
  new_tsfm_model(
    architecture = "demo",
    config = config,
    capabilities = new_tsfm_capabilities("demo", max_context = 128L),
    predict_fn = function(context, h, quantile_levels) {
      if (length(context) == 0L) stop("empty context")
      last <- context[length(context)]
      outer(rep(last, h), stats::qnorm(quantile_levels), `+`)
    }
  )
}

report <- tsfm_check_architecture(demo_arch, error = FALSE)
#> ✔ Architecture satisfies the tsfm contract (8 checks passed).
report
#>                                                  name   ok
#> 1                    constructor returns a tsfm_model TRUE
#> 2                               declares capabilities TRUE
#> 3                           stamps a contract version TRUE
#> 4          predict_fn returns an h x q numeric matrix TRUE
#> 5                                forecasts are finite TRUE
#> 6          quantiles are non-decreasing across levels TRUE
#> 7       empty context errors rather than returning NA TRUE
#> 8  a single observation is handled or refused cleanly TRUE
#> 9                   respects its declared max_context   NA
#> 10            predict_batch_fn agrees with predict_fn   NA
#>                                                                                                                        message
#> 1                                                                                                                         <NA>
#> 2                                                                                                                         <NA>
#> 3                                                                                                                         <NA>
#> 4                                                                                                                         <NA>
#> 5                                                                                                                         <NA>
#> 6                                                                                                                         <NA>
#> 7                                                                                                                         <NA>
#> 8                                                                                                                         <NA>
#> 9  Not exercised: the probe context (72 values) is shorter than max_context (128). Pass a longer `context` to check the limit.
#> 10                                                              No predict_batch_fn supplied; the engine will loop predict_fn.
